review_scope: Independent visual review of nine v2 renders plus source-opening/script consistency; not a restoration, structural or printability certificate.
model: Songshan Tobacco Factory No.1 warehouse,2004-01 surveyed exterior study

views.finding: Whole south-west building contained with margin. South five through-arches, west return, narrow long-face fields and source-bounded annex visible.
Whole north-east building contained with margin. North irregular shed and east-south low annex differentiated; no extra warehouse units.

Four high gable sash groups and circular marker visible after roof-end fix. Low north wall has two2x3side windows and uninterrupted central opaque door; unsupported centerpost removed. Entire annex/base now in frame.
Five round arch openings plus four gable sash groups, circular marker and finial visible. Entire annex/base in frame; six dimension modules not mistaken for six arches.
Sixteen visible high sash/vertical fields; south three main fields occluded by annex, not fabricated. Three stepped buttresses in intended central zones. North shed does not inherit west door.

Nineteen small high sashes with narrow pale vertical fields and low vents; courses between fields, not across invented broad louvre panels. Three stepped buttresses; west north shed door now neutral opaque.
Single double-pitched main roof, irregular north extension, south low arcade roof and east-south inferred cap; no No2–5 roof mass or workshop dormers.
Intentional detail crop reveals depth through five south arches and west return. Gable glazing/round marker no longer buried.
Intentional detail crop reveals low V-like north shed, open narrow diagonal strip and two windows plus central door without centerpost. Main gable details visible.

resolved_v1_findings: Previously buried gable details now visible.
Long-face fields narrowed; unsupported internal horizontal rails removed.
Seven generic tapered buttresses replaced by three source-positioned stepped proxies per face.
West shed door glazing changed to neutral field.
Both end elevations reframed to contain complete modeled footprint.
source_basis: No1 isolated gable identified separately from connected No2–5 group.
limitations: Longitudinal plan/elevation dimension conflict remains disclosed; source dimensions are not asserted identical.
East-south annex cap, north shed profile, minor supports, frames and relief depths remain explicit geometric estimates.
High opening fields are neutral simplified opaque surfaces, not confirmation of intact original leaves.
Common small gable-window head/detail profiles and fine finish are simplified; no claim to full ornamental reproduction.
South connection toward other warehouses ends at documented model boundary without invented historical closure.
Interiors, hidden trusses, plumbing and unobserved annex-covered openings excluded.
No physical trial print, structural safety assessment or present-restored-condition certification.
publication_safety: Authored observations, relative package paths and file hashes only; no source photos/PDF or private absolute paths.
